messages:
alex: pushing the rollout now to prod-202
alex: targeting 14:32 PT window, will flip traffic 10% -> 100% over 6m, can people eyeball critical checks? :eyes:
deploy-bot: deploy started for service=inference-api user=alex commit=7f3c1a env=prod-202
miri: watching infra metrics, I'll run quick health probes and a few smoke prompts
miri: running curl health and a couple generation checks
miri: ```
curl -sS https://prod-202.inference.redwood/api/health | jq .status
# => "ok"
curl -sS -X POST https://prod-202.inference.redwood/api/generate -d '{"prompt":"Summarize in one line: The quick brown fox"}' | jq .text
# => "The quick brown fox jumps over the lazy dog."
```
sam: tailing logs for tokenization errors and OOMs
sam: logs look clean so far, no OOMs on gpus 2/3
oncall-ryan: I’m on pager duty, monitoring latency dashboards, set alert thresholds to +20% baseline
pat: quick note — 95th pct latency bumped ~12% for short seq requests 2m after flip, not alarming but keeping an eye
miri: DAG checks passed; KV cache warmup in progress (expected to finish ~3m). If we see >25% latency, we rollback.
ci-bot: canary smoke tests: all checks green (runnable-ops, auth, kv, metrics-hook)
alex: can we confirm rollout config and rollback ready state? paste the rollout plan snippet
miri: rollout snippet:
```
strategy:
  type: progressive
  steps: [10, 30, 60, 100]
  pause_between_steps: 120s
rollback_on:
  - latency_increase_percent > 25
  - error_rate > 1%
```
miri: rollback job is staged and I have the helm rollback command ready
sam: quick remedial patch staged in branch hotfix/trim-kv, but not needed yet
pat: opened a tiny dashboard card to track quick-turn metrics: tokens/sec, 95th latency, 4xx/5xx
oncall-ryan: alerting rules already updated to include the new service tag
miri: after step->30% I rechecked traffic routing and no errors, KV hit rate ~87%
alex: thanks — if anyone sees unusual error spikes ping me AND @oncall-ryan, otherwise we complete the ramp and I’ll post final status
sam: seen one transient 503 at 14:39 PT but retried ok, counts as flake
miri: final check: health ok, small latency bump within expected, no errors. proceeding to 100%
deploy-bot: rollout completed for service=inference-api commit=7f3c1a to 100% traffic
alex: nice work everyone, will keep this thread open for 30m to capture any quick fixes
pat: noted one tiny config tweak needed for monitoring labels, will open PR
miri: PR for metric label fix: https://github.com/redwood-inference/infra/pull/412 :link:
oncall-ryan: all quiet from paging side, standing down in 15m unless something pops
alex: closing after monitoring window; thanks :rocket:
